_status: APPROVED by Ryno on 2026-10-09 from the pricing recommendation. Edit prices, standard rates, delivery and payment here, then run: node scripts/build.mjs. No payment links are connected; clients are invoiced by PayPal in US dollars.
pilotSummary: Each package starts as a 30-day paid pilot. If it works for you, you can continue month to month on a retainer at the same scope. Nothing renews automatically, and retainer terms are agreed in writing.
foundingNote: Founding client pricing: the price shown is held for your first 3 months in exchange for a written or video testimonial after delivery. I only publish a testimonial or case study with your written approval of the final wording. The standard monthly rate applies to clients after the founding period.
retainerDiscount: A 10% discount on the monthly rate applies if you commit to a 3-month or 6-month retainer in advance.
clockStart: Delivery times are counted in business days from the day I have both your payment (or deposit) and your completed intake form.
intakeNote: The intake covers your voice and tone, your top three specialties, and who you want to reach. Please do not send patient or client names, records or photos.
